proved: The root bootstrap carries and verifies the exact sealed manifest digest before downstream routing.
All covered local runtime bytes, Current Map targets, historical Home bytes, and external script identities are exact and complete for the exercised source set.
The integrity Service Worker verifies covered bytes before response and blocks unlisted executable sources.
One-byte tampering of the manifest, integrity worker, resolver, Current Map, Guardian, cached source, and historical Home fails closed.
A digest mismatch never falls back to a previously verified cache response.
Offline fallback is allowed only for cached bytes that still match the exact expected digest.
External scripts receive exact SHA-256 SRI after the containing local document is verified.
All six current screens, tools, recovery paths, and fourteen historic forwarders remain functional under enforcement.
No protected downstream component can replace the integrity Service Worker.

certification_truth.meaning: This is an unrestricted pass for the complete exercised A-003 repository and browser runtime source-byte enforcement scope. The explicit bootstrap root cannot verify its own pre-execution bytes, and browser Service Worker registration lacks native SRI; signed or immutable deployment controls are required to eliminate a malicious-origin swap during that narrow registration interval.
